findings.detail: Description of "beta_signup" contains imperative instructions directed at the AI assistant rather than describing the tool. This is the core tool-poisoning technique.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: pgx_lookup, beta_signup, research_access · Private data: verify_text, allele_info, validate_gl_string, beta_signup, research_access · Public sink: verify_text, validate_gl_string, beta_signup, research_access, about.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: pgx_lookup, beta_signup, research_access · Private data: verify_text, allele_info, validate_gl_string, beta_signup, research_access · Public sink: verify_text, validate_gl_string, beta_signup, research_access, about

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "verify_text" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.
